Jazz Oral History Project
Interview with Woody Herman by Herb Wong
Cassette 1

PRO-TYPISTS, INC.
PROFESSIONAL TRANSCRIPTION SERVICE
AREA CODE 202 347-5895

MR. WONG: This is a special interview with Woody Herman, and I'm Herb Wong, the interviewer. It is part of the Jazz Oral History Project, sponsored through the funds of the National Endowment of the Arts and conducted by the Smithsonian Institution.

The interview was conducted in two segments, the first in Hollywood, in Woody's residence in December of 1978, and the second part in Berkeley, a few weeks later, in January. The interview consumed approximately six hours of time. And here's how it went.
MR. WONG: -- with Woody Herman at his residence in Hollywood. December 20, 1978. Woody, You just returned from New York, right?
You just finished playing back East in a tour?

Well, actually we were in Florida about ten days ago, and we went down there for three dates and worked the Carolinas coming back, and got into Virginia and then finally into New York for a couple of private Christmas parties.
